items.title: Jason Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a teacher, Dr. Steven Danker, who taught music theory and taught classical music in the repertoire.

ctx.x: No. I didn’t have any scores. I just put – I took the jazz musician [?] – I just put it on and would listen. I just listened to what instrument is doing what. What is going on? There was a lot of details that I found later, looking into the scores that I didn’t know

at the time, that amazed me even more. But I didn’t have – I didn’t use that. It’s great to do that, but at the time, I just didn’t do that. I just put it on and listened. Man, what is going on? It just amazed me. So that’s when I started to get into – at the time, I’m also attending the New Orleans Center for Creative Arts. There was a teacher, Dr. Steven Danker, who taught music theory and taught classical music in the repertoire. I was starting to get into that while listening to this. So I’m getting…
When you say practice, what are you practicing?
